content:
{'translation': 'This year\'s DSE has a total of 58,487 candidates, with 43,543 from day schools. A total of 15,973 students achieved the "332A33" university basic entry threshold. This cohort of the Diploma Examinations produced 24 "top scorers" who attained 5** in six subjects, the highest number on record, comprising 14 males and 10 females. Among them, 11 candidates also obtained 5** in the mathematics extension module to become "super top scorers," comprising 6 males and 5 females. However, no "ultimate top scorer" achieving 5** in seven or more subjects was seen this year.', 'text': '[1] 被問到狀元數目創歷年新高的原因，考評局秘書長魏向東表示，考試評核根據水平參照，「難易程度係一樣」，部份「叻嘅同學」令整體表現有所上升，試卷難易程度沒有關係。'}

{'translation': 'Regarding the reasons for the record-high number of top scorers, HKEAA Secretary-General Wei Xiangdong stated that examination assessments are criterion-referenced, and the "level of difficulty remains the same." The rise in overall performance is attributed to some "outstanding students," and is unrelated to the difficulty level of the examination papers.', 'text': '[2] 整體成績方面，本屆共有15,973名考生成功考獲「332A33」的成績，達到8間資助大學的基本入學要求，數量比上年稍微下跌，魏向東表示「整體成績平穩」，能達到大學的基本入學要求的考生仍高於過去5年的平均數。'}

{'translation': 'In terms of overall results, a total of 15,973 candidates in this cohort successfully achieved the "332A33" results, meeting the basic entry requirements of the eight government-funded universities. The number represents a slight decrease compared to last year. Wei Xiangdong noted that "overall results are stable," and the number of candidates meeting universities\' basic entry requirements remains higher than the average over the past five years.', 'text': '[3] 另外，亦有30,977名日校考生成功考獲「五科2級」的成績，達到本地副學士課程的基本入學要求，佔整體日校考生73.2%，比上年上升425人。'}

{'translation': 'In addition, 30,977 day school candidates successfully achieved "Level 2 in five subjects," meeting the basic entry requirements for local associate degree programmes. This represents 73.2% of all day school candidates, an increase of 425 compared to last year.', 'text': '[4] 今屆文憑試的報考人數為58,487人，有56,853人出席，總人數比上年上升5.4%。其中今屆的日校考生及自修生數量分別為43,534人及12,143人，對比上年分別上升2.2%及19.5%。另外，今屆共有4,676名有特殊教育需要的考生獲特別考試安排，比上年上升約15%，教育局亦為此設立約850個特別考試場地。'}

{'translation': 'The number of candidates registered for this cohort of the Diploma Examinations is 58,487, with 56,853 in attendance, representing a 5.4% increase in total numbers compared to last year. Among them, day school candidates and private candidates numbered 43,534 and 12,143 respectively, representing increases of 2.2% and 19.5% compared to last year. Additionally, 4,676 candidates with special educational needs received special examination arrangements this cohort, an increase of approximately 15% compared to last year. The Education Bureau also established around 850 special examination venues for this purpose.', 'text': '[5] 針對共有7名考生出現作弊情況，其中3名考生涉及核心科目，有一名考生於視覺藝術的校本評核出現嚴重抄襲，該名學生的成績已被下降一級，魏向東教授強調「請考生一定要睇清楚考生嘅手冊」，避免考生不清楚考試的規則以及理解錯誤。'}

{'translation': 'Regarding the seven candidates involved in examination malpractices, three of them were involved in core subjects. One candidate committed serious plagiarism in the Visual Arts school-based assessment, and that student\'s result has been downgraded by one level. Professor Wei Xiangdong emphasised that "candidates must read the candidate handbook carefully" to avoid being unaware of examination rules or misunderstanding them.', 'text': '[6] 教育局指今屆文憑試共有十幾名宏福苑的考生，火災事發當時亦已提供熱線援助，表示暫時未收到來自宏福苑考生的求助。'}

{'translation': 'The Education Bureau indicated that over ten candidates from Wang Fuk Court sat this cohort of the Diploma Examinations. A hotline was provided at the time of the fire incident, and no requests for assistance have been received from candidates at Wang Fuk Court so far.', 'text': '[7] 另外，今屆文憑試是內地考文憑試的第三年試行，魏向東教授指整體運作順暢，亦方便了部分家庭及考生，表示正在考慮及研究繼續實行的可行性。除此之外，本屆年齡最低的考生為11歲，共考一科得到4的評級，年齡最高的考生為72歲的自修生。'}

{'translation': 'Furthermore, this cohort of the Diploma Examinations marks the third year of the trial scheme for sitting the DSE in mainland China. Professor Wei Xiangdong stated that the overall operation was smooth and provided convenience for some families and candidates, and that the feasibility of continuing the scheme is being considered and studied. In addition, the youngest candidate in this cohort was 11 years old, who sat one subject and attained a Level 4 rating, while the oldest candidate was a 72-year-old private candidate.'}
